hookups.source: https://www.eastjordancity.org/departments/parks___recreation.php ('75 of which are full-hookups with water, electricity and sewer connections'; 'Electric (30 amp Service) 50 amp Service on Select Sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The city counts 90 campsites: 75 full-hookup, 12 tent sites with no hookups and 3 cabins. Back-in only except four pull-through sites (59/61, 60 and 70 or 75). One camper, trailer or RV and two vehicles per site; tent campers may stay two weeks at most.

sites.source: https://www.eastjordancity.org/departments/parks___recreation.php ('our comfortable campground offers 90 campsites, 75 of which are full-hookups ... We also have 12 tent campsites (with no hook-ups) and 3 cabins') + park rules.pdf ('BACK IN ONLY. (#59.61, #60 & #70 are pull through sites)', 'Sites are limited to one camper, trailer or RV per campsite', 'Maximum of two (2) vehicles', 'Maximum stay for tent campers—Two Weeks') + Rates 2024.pdf ('Pull Through (60, 59/61, & 75)'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.eastjordancity.org/departments/parks___recreation.php ('Wifi internet access available throughout the park'; 'Camp Store – RV Parts – Camping Supplies') + park rules.pdf ('Park Restrooms locked from 11pm – 5am; Beach Showers by the office') + Rates 2024.pdf ('Showers: $5.00', 'Dumpstation: $5.00'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online through the city's CampLife page, in person, by phone, mail or e-mail, up to 6 months ahead. Three-night minimum on holiday weekends including the Freedom Festival and Fall Festival (the 2024 rate sheet also sets three nights from June 23 to July 10). 50% deposit, full payment for stays of three nights or less. Stays of 30+ days are booked from September 15 for the next season.

booking.source: https://www.eastjordancity.org/Document Center/Department/Parks & Recreation/Tourist Park/143-Tourist-Park-Reservation-Policy-002.pdf ('up to 6 months in advance of check in date', 'A two-night minimum rental is required for all weekends from Memorial Day through Labor Day. A three-night minimum rental is required for all holiday weekends including Freedom Festival and Fall Festival') + Rates 2024.pdf ('*Three night minimum June 23rd - July 10th') + the city page's 'Tourist Park Online Reservations' link (CampLife park 253, City of East Jordan Tourist Park), read 2026-10-22

note: Municipal campground owned/operated by the City of East Jordan on the south arm of Lake Charlevoix at 218 N Lake St, with boat slips and a public swimming beach. RV Life 4*/2$ (auto 6/2026). --Claude
summary: City pages confirm 90 sites (75 full-hookup with 30-amp, 50-amp on select sites, 12 tent, 3 cabins), water/sewer, wifi, camp store; added 4 pull-throughs (otherwise back-in), showers/restrooms/dump, CampLife booking link, 6-month window, 2-night summer-weekend and 3-night holiday minimums. Fees left as the 2026-10 CampLife quote ($43.50-57.50, pull-through $78.50); the city's 2024 sheet had $40-52 and $70, with no resident/non-resident split. Season not stated (office keeps winter hours). Monthly and seasonal (4-6 month) rates exist, but the park books short stays online and is not mostly seasonal on its pages (no seasonal count given). Note: site counts and booking text dropped (now in fields).
flags: Website: the second link is CampLife's marketplace page; the city's own booking page is https://www.camplife.com/253/reservation/step1 (City of East Jordan Tourist Park). The www.eastjordantouristpark.com address named in the reservation policy now redirects to the city parks page.
